Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model

Class Table

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.Table
public class Table extends Object
Represents the central table (pile) in the Cincuentazo game.

The table maintains a stack of played cards and a running sum of their values. The sum must never exceed 50; any attempt to place a card that would cause an overflow throws an InvalidMoveException.

When the deck is exhausted, all cards except the top one can be collected via collectForRefill() and returned to the deck.

  • Method Details

    • placeInitialCard

      public void placeInitialCard(Card card) throws InvalidMoveException
      Places a card onto the table, updating the running sum.

      This method is used both for the initial card of a round and for subsequent plays. It validates that the new sum does not exceed 50.

      Parameters:
      card - the Card to place; must not be null
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if placing the card would push the sum above 50

    • collectForRefill

      public List<Card> collectForRefill()
      Removes all cards from the pile except the top card and returns them so they can be shuffled back into the deck.

      The top card is kept on the table to preserve the current sum state.

      Returns:
      a List of all cards that were below the top card
